message:

hold_reason: Refund mismatch on order 240: the signed Alpha batch requested 8145 cents, but the refund ledger shows only 2433 cents applied (difference 5712 cents). Net balances computed from the ledger would overpay the customer on that order. Orders 243 (13498) and 245 (10428) match. No payouts recorded. Needs human review of order 240 before paying.

reply.thought: The handoff shows a mismatch: order 240 had 8145 requested but only 2433 reported applied. Before paying anyone, I'll check the actual refund ledger rather than trust the handoff summary.

The refund ledger shows order 240 applied at 2433 cents, but the signed batch requested 8145 cents. Paying net balances computed from this ledger could overpay the affected customer by 5712 cents, and payouts can't be recalled. I'll hold the batch for human review.
